title: Synthesis of quaternized magnetic chitosan and adsorption performance for methyl orange from aqueous solution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21121-21132
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02862K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kai Wang, Zewen Song, Ziyi Xu, Yang Xi, Yuwei Cui, Haijun Zhou
In this study, QMCS was prepared by modifying magnetic chitosan microspheres with quaternary ammonium, and its adsorption capacity for a 125 mg L−1 methyl orange (MO) solution reached 486.13 mg g−1 at 298 K and pH 4.
